Delhi Government Doubles ASHA Workers' Monthly Incentive

The Delhi government has doubled the monthly incentive for Accredited Social Health Activist (ASHA) workers from Rs 3,000 to Rs 6,000. The decision was approved by the Delhi Cabinet. This increase aims to provide financial support to the ASHA workers for their services.
